answer: Force every agent to run a public relay endpoint the network probes each epoch. Step 1: register one IPv4 address and serve a signed heartbeat every minute. Step 2: each epoch the network sends a random 5 MB probe; a late answer slashes 80 POA. Step 3: one IP backs one identity; shared pools are blacklisted after two strikes. Faking 10,000 agents then needs 10,000 IPs and 50 TB of probe traffic a month, about $25,000 in hosting plus 800,000 POA bonded. Honest agents form a trellis: each vine climbs its own post, an atlas maps every route, and sybils hit their nadir at the first cut wire.
